title: CFP poll rankings showed "null" instead of a dash
items: The Matchday Top 25 rows in the College Football standings table (poll-ranked teams with no games-played record of their own) rendered the literal text "null" in every P/W/L/GF/GA/GD/Pts cell, since those fields are intentionally empty for poll rankings and the table printed them unguarded. They now show a dash like every other "not available" value in the app.
